# word,definition
banana, a long curved fruit with a yellow peel
glacier, a slow-moving river of ice
marigold, a bright orange or gold flower
camouflage, clothing or coloring that hides you in plain sight
tranquility, a state of peaceful calm
brisk, quick and full of energy
luminous, glowing with soft light
meander, to wander slowly without a firm direction
island, land completely surrounded by water
harvest, the gathering of ripe crops
